integrity: All exact code and the complete 18-orbit catalogue are embedded; full executable checks passed. Scientific and publication-priority uncertainties are disclosed.
scientific_limitations: The result is a finite characteristic-two classification for degree-five plane curves. A 2024 exhaustive genus-six database includes all smooth binary plane-quintic equations; the claimed new contribution is the rational tangent-incidence if-and-only-if characterization, not the raw census. Exact finite-field Gröbner computations provide proof steps; no independent audit has been performed.
title: A rational tangent-incidence criterion for smooth plane-filling quintics over \(\mathbf F_2\)
